title: T2 mobile-menu fix misses the 'See all guides' playlist link row — still ~37px
evidence:
attribute("data-testid", "mobile-help-playlist-link"),
            attribute.href(copy.help_playlist_url),
            attribute("target", "_blank"),
            attribute("rel", "noopener noreferrer"),
            event.on_click(msg.UserToggledMobileMenu),
            class("text-amber font-headline text-sm py-2 block"),
detail: The T2 hunk raised dashboard, notifications, settings, sign-out and guide links to min-h-[44px], but this interactive menu row (findings table scopes T2 to 'mobile-nav-*, mobile-help-*') keeps py-2 block, rendering ~37px.
recommended_fix: Add min-h-[44px] flex items-center to the playlist link class, matching view_mobile_help_link.

title: Select-mode action bar keeps the unwrapped layout and 36px buttons the comparison-bar fix replaced
evidence:
[class("max-w-5xl mx-auto flex items-center justify-between gap-4")],
          [
            html.span(
              [class("text-sm font-medium text-charcoal whitespace-nowrap")],
              [html.text(count_label)],
            ),
...
                  "text-sm text-slate hover:text-charcoal transition-colors h-9 px-3",
...
                  "border border-score-red text-score-red font-headline font-semibold rounded-lg h-9 px-4 text-sm hover:bg-score-red/5 transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed",
detail: This bar swaps into the exact fixed-bottom slot the diff fixed, and its header says it 'Mirrors the comparison_bar layout' — but it keeps no flex-wrap, a nowrap label over a min-w-0 div, and two h-9 (36px) CTAs, so the 320px overlap this PR fixed persists in select mode.
recommended_fix: Mirror the comparison_bar fix here: flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-1 on the row, min-h-[44px] inline-flex items-center on both buttons.

title: Settings page password toggle keeps an unpadded ~16px hit area unchanged by T3
detail: T3 padded the shared auth_layout toggle (p-2 -m-2), but settings_security renders its own toggle with no padding around a w-4 h-4 icon — same defect class, smaller than the 20px auth toggles were.
recommended_fix: Apply p-2 -m-2 to the settings_security toggle class (or reuse auth_layout's view_password_field).
